profile.headline: Software Engineer at Amentum
profile.summary: Highly motivated, and resourceful Software Engineer with experience designing and developing software in C++, Java, Python, and Embedded Systems.  Cover a wide breadth of areas from kernel drivers to enterprise tools and applications.  Team player with excellent communication skills that thrives in solving technical problems, collaborating with other groups, and delivering products in traditional and Agile/Scrum based software projects.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Engineering · Software Industry

positions.title: Senior Systems Engineer
positions.description:
Developed new enhancements for HP BIOSCFG Linux driver and integrated support for firmware-attribute framework. Integration of firmware-attribute framework support allowed the driver to be approved and incorporated as part of the Linux Kernel version 6.6. 

Developed security applications in C++/C# for Sure Recover and Sure Admin under Windows to provide value-add and security for Business notebooks. Sure Recover and Sure Admin are security tools to recover a notebook OS image and to configure BIOS settings in a secure manner. 

•	Collaborated with development teams throughout US and test teams in India. 
•	Knowledgeable in the Agile software development process. 
•	Introduced network tests to emulate network traffic conditions. The network traffic was controlled to simulate network conditions encountered by users in the field such transmission delays, network traffic, and drop and loss packets. 
•	Worked with Linux community to submit, review comments, and provide updates in a timely manner.
•	Wrote code using a clear concept of solid principles, coding development standards, and guidelines.
•	Responsible for implementation, test, and documentation of functional software solutions.
•	Handled multiple projects simultaneously, met deadlines, while effectively managing priorities and communicating progress.
•	Performed thorough design reviews and code reviews with team.
•	Actively worked with other engineers in cross-functional, cross-geographical development teams to fully understand project scope.
•	Led and participated in code reviews, design reviews, architecture discussions, and team meetings.
•	Developed and maintained high-quality software documentation and specifications.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed new enhancements for HPE OneView next generation in Java, Spring Framework, and RESTful web services by leveraging industry standards and web-based interfaces for network adapters under Linux.  HPE OneView is an integrated IT infrastructure management software that automates IT operations and simplifies infrastructure lifecycle management across compute, storage, and networking.

    • Collaborated with teams throughout the US, India, and China.  
    • Knowledgeable in the Agile software development process.  
    • Developed tools in Python to query information from all devices in the enclosure via RIS (DMTF Redfish) interface. 
    • Self-taught and formal training on Go, Docker, Containers and Kubernetes (K8s).
    • Introduced network adapter tests to fault injection automation system.  Fault injection automation system is a test environment used to inject responses caused by invalid programming of the adapter, and hardware/firmware failures.
    • Worked with quality organization to resolve issues reported in the field by critical accounts, by identifying the failure, providing a quick resolution, and working with other groups to improve the stability of OneView product.
• Worked closely with network hardware vendors and assisted in the triage of issues reported by other teams.  This close work relationship improved product quality, reduced number of issues captured in the field, and resolution of issues identified early in the firmware and OneView development process. 
• Wrote code using a clear concept of solid principles, coding development standards, and guidelines.
• Performed thorough design reviews and code reviews with team.
• Actively worked with other engineers in cross-functional, cross-geographical development teams to fully understand project scope.
• Led and participated in code reviews, design reviews, and team meetings.
• Developed and maintained high-quality software documentation and specifications.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed new enhancements for the Onboard Administrator (OA).  OA is an embedded management system which controls the operation of shared resources such as power supplies, network and storage interfaces, shared storage across enclosures of HPE Blades. 

    • Designed new enhancements for the Onboard Administrator firmware and resolved issues reported in the field.  
    • Designed and wrote applications in C#/C++/COM under Windows to provide value-add and security for Business notebooks.   Enhanced Java Card Security plug-in to expand HP ProtectTools Security capabilities by allowing users to configure Smart Cards as an authentication token.  HP ProtectTools Security Manager is used to prevent unauthorized access using Smart Cards, TPM Embedded security chips, USB tokens and other security technologies. 
    • Developed software to protect the internal hard drives in the event of a shock by leveraging the accelerometer chip capabilities. Development was in C++/C and incorporated into HP 3d DriveGuard product.
    • Designed and wrote applications in C++ under both Windows and Linux platforms to diagnose a variety of devices in the factory and field.  Those devices include Storage (RAID, SATA, CISS and IDE controllers and drives), Audio, and Video devices  
    • Worked closely with vendors and provided technical assistance in special projects in order to meet all goals without jeopardizing functionality, streamline the factory process, improve quality, and reduce support costs.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and wrote applications in C++/MFC/COM to provide value added applications for the new server blades.  Those applications included Console Snap-in applets and provider DLL to display information stored in the CIMV2 space.  

Designed and wrote SNMP applications to exchange server blade information across Windows and Linux platforms.  

Designed and wrote drivers to proactively access device data via IPMI SMIC interface.

Designed and wrote serial console applications to allow the customer to recover during an out of band state.  This application helped  the customer to reconfigure any or all three available NICs and run tasks from the command line.  

Designed and wrote tools to took advantage of the headless environment and provide other means for the application to report data to an administrator.

Provided support to both Windows and Linux test teams.  Interacted with third party vendor and helped in the resolution of the problems.

Experienced building Linux kernels for cluster OS and applying patches to overcome problems found in the field and by the industry.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and wrote applications in C++/MFC to provide new  functionality and value-add features to HP home router/gateway devices.  Those applications included a range of control panel applets, GUI interfaces, and applications used to communicate with other embedded devices.  Several applications used Component Object Model (COM) to enable inter-process communication between components provided by the OS and/or third parties.

Designed and wrote applications that leverage SOAP web services and  UPnP networking protocols to seamlessly discover new devices by the rest of the network.  

Designed and developed Windows NT (Kernel), WDM and VxD drivers in C/C++ to provide flexibility and programmability for the HP Internet/Multimedia Keyboard.  

Prepared and presented 3 separate sessions on how to write WDM drivers, differences between WDM and Kernel drivers, and how to write ACPI aware drivers.
